Bash To Ash Help and Support

Updated: 14 October 2026

Developer: Rawan Alghamdi

Contact: bashtoash@gmail.com

Help, the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use are included in the app and can be read offline. Open Settings > Support & privacy. Sending email, account operations, purchases and ad privacy forms need a connection.

Contact us

Use Copy email to copy bashtoash@gmail.com, or Email support to open your email app. If no email app is configured, paste the address into the email service you normally use. Nothing is sent until you choose to send it.

For a bug, include what happened, the steps that caused it, your app version and device model, and whether it happened offline, in a private room, in public matching, in Ranks or while using the Shop. Share a screenshot only if you want to. Do not send passwords, sign-in tokens or payment-card details.

Save or recover your progress

Return Home and leave any room or public queue before changing accounts. Open Settings > Account > Link account and finish the provider sign-in. Then choose Cloud backup to save your public nickname and chosen country, supported looks, favorites, achievement and event progress, and match records. The private defender nickname stays on the device; it is different from your public profile name.

On another device, use Settings > Account > Recover account and sign in to the same linked account. Read any save-conflict choices before selecting which profile to use. The game service retrieves that account's Account coins and server-recorded outfit ownership. A guest account that was never linked may not be recoverable after its device session is lost. Cloud backup is separate from the Account coins wallet and does not back up Device coins, ownership of outfits bought with Device coins, locally earned reward-card stock and its claim journal, or every local setting.

Public profile, rankings and online matches

Open Your profile from the Home profile entry or Settings to edit your public nickname and optional country. Your nickname is visible to other players in online features. Country rankings use your choice, not GPS; leave it unset if you do not want to choose one. Your private defender name stays on this device.

World, country and friends competitive rankings use verified public results. Your player identifier, public nickname, chosen country, league and ranking results can be received by other signed-in players even when you view only friends. Offline trophies and private-match records are separate. The legacy trophy board can share a generated name and client-reported offline progress with Unity Leaderboards; it is not a verified skill ranking. A starting rating is provisional until verified public results are available.

Public matching, when available, keeps all selected players in the same league with a maximum 100-point rating gap. If no eligible match is available, leave the queue or try again later. The game does not widen the allowed gap while you wait. A missing verification service cannot confirm an online result or an account-card bonus. If a result remains pending, reconnect using the same account and contact support instead of repeatedly submitting it.

Use REPORT PLAYER from an available player action in Ranks, Friends or an online opponent list. Choose Offensive name, Harassment, Impersonation or Other, then explicitly confirm submission. The app shows that a report was received only after the service confirms its saved receipt. A failed or cancelled submission is unconfirmed; retry the same report when offered. Receipt does not mean that a moderation decision has been made.

If you cannot submit the report or need further help, use Email support in Support & privacy. Include the displayed nickname or player reference and what happened, without sharing sign-in secrets. Friends lets you decline requests, remove friends and block players. Blocks also prevent future public matching with blocked players after the block list is checked; they do not automatically disconnect an ongoing match.

Purchases or missing Coins

Check which Shop balance you are viewing. Device coins are earned from completed matches and free rewards and remain on this device. Account coins include server-verified ad earnings, eligible account-card bonuses, gift and referral rewards, and purchased Coins stored with your game account. Outfits must be bought entirely from one balance; the Shop identifies the source and offers a choice when both balances can cover the price. Account coins cannot top up an insufficient Device coins balance for one outfit.

A guest can earn Account coins from ads, but coin-pack, reward-card-pack and pass purchases require a linked, recoverable game account. Confirm that the same game account is open and the correct Apple account is used for purchases. Connect to the internet and choose Restore purchases in the Shop. A pending purchase can need Apple approval or service confirmation. Avoid buying again while delivery is pending.

Restore can recover verified non-consumable entitlements. It does not grant a spent coin pack or consumed reward card again, or recover Device coins and device-only outfits. Cached, previously verified account entitlements let you equip supported owned cosmetics offline for up to 24 hours after the last verified refresh. Reconnect to verify and renew that access; this limit does not apply to Device coins or outfits bought with them. Spending Account coins requires a connection. If a completed purchase is missing, contact support with the product and approximate purchase time. We may ask for the transaction reference to locate it. Apple handles refund requests through its purchase support.

Rewarded ads and missing rewards

Ads are optional. The offer shows its exact reward before you watch. No available ad, declining an offer or closing before the viewing requirement is complete does not affect your normal play or earned match rewards. Clicking the ad or buying the advertised product is never required.

A completed reward is added to Account coins, not Device coins, and can remain pending while the service confirms it. Reconnect using the same game account and allow delivery to finish. If it remains missing, contact support with the approximate time and displayed reward; you do not need to watch another ad or make a purchase.

For an inappropriate or misleading ad, open the rewarded offer on Home > REPORT AD. This reports the most recently shown ad. Choose Inappropriate content, Not suitable for this age, Misleading ad or Technical problem. The app submits the reason and the recent ad's reference information; a pending report retries when it can connect. You can also email support. You do not need to click the advertisement to report it.

Reward cards, gifts and referrals

Reward cards do not play a video. On the completed-match results screen, review the bonus and confirm USE 1 CARD. Earned cards work offline and add Device coins. Cards stored with your account, including purchased and gift cards, need a linked account, a connection and a verified online result to add Account coins. An offline match cannot verify that account reward. A refund adjustment can reduce the available bonus; review the amount shown. If delivery is pending, use RETRY REWARD for the same claim instead of spending another card.

Open Share & gifts from the game's reward or Friends actions. In Gifts, enter the complete gift code and choose REDEEM GIFT. Each code can be redeemed once per account, subject to its expiry and overall limit. Coins or account cards appear only after the service confirms redemption. Gift and referral Coin grants can first settle an outstanding refund adjustment; the remaining Coins become available in your account balance.

In Referrals, create a link to copy or share, or paste a received link or code and choose REVIEW. Review the referring game account before sending a friend request. A qualifying new friendship must be accepted and verified with CHECK REFERRAL before rewards are granted. Opening a share sheet, sharing the game or sending a room invitation does not earn a reward. A referral link expires after seven days. The current offer grants 100 Account coins to each qualifying participant before refund adjustments; an account can receive one invitee reward and up to ten referrer rewards. Reconnect to the same linked account to check a pending reward; do not send support the complete gift or referral code unless asked through your support conversation.

Privacy choices

• Optional gameplay analytics: Settings > Share gameplay data. Turning it off stops collection and requests deletion of previously collected installation analytics. • Advertising: Settings > Support & privacy > Ad privacy choices. Review your locally stored age band and the provider's privacy options where available for your region. After an age band is saved, later launches refresh the provider's consent status without automatically opening a form; required forms wait until you choose an ad or open privacy options. No birth date is collected, and selecting an older band gives no extra reward. • Public profile: change your nickname or chosen country in Your profile. This does not make previously shared public information private. • Friends: decline requests, remove friends or block players in Friends. • Privacy questions or data access and correction requests: email bashtoash@gmail.com.

Delete a game account

Open Settings > Account > Delete game account, read the consequences and confirm. This works for guest and linked game accounts. You can also reach Account through Support & privacy > Account & data.

The app shows Pending while the required game-account deletion steps are unfinished and Completed after they succeed. Deletion removes account access, cloud profile, public ranking profile, match participation records, friends, leaderboard data, wallet, player reports and associated gift, referral and reward-card records. Unity may still be processing the separate analytics deletion request after game-account deletion is complete, and limited financial, deletion, result-replay and security records may remain as described in the Privacy Policy. Valid results and rewards belonging to other players are not cancelled. Deleting the app alone does not delete server records.

Game-account deletion is separate from deleting a Unity Player Account or an Apple account, and does not automatically refund a purchase. Use the separate provider-account option in Account if you also want to manage or delete that provider account. You do not need to email us to start game-account deletion.

For data disclosure or other privacy requests about your separate Unity Player Account, contact unity-player-login-privacy@unity3d.com. To delete that provider account, use https://player-account.unity.com/delete-account.

The same holds for its supporting scripts (config.guess, config.sub, ltconfig, ltmain.sh). Another support script, install-sh, is copyright by M.I.T. but is also freely distributable.

It appears that the arithmetic coding option of the JPEG spec is covered by patents owned by IBM, AT&T, and Mitsubishi. Hence arithmetic coding cannot legally be used without obtaining one or more licenses. For this reason, support for arithmetic coding has been removed from the free JPEG software. (Since arithmetic coding provides only a marginal gain over the unpatented Huffman mode, it is unlikely that very many implementations will support it.) So far as we are aware, there are no patent restrictions on the remaining code.

The IJG distribution formerly included code to read and write GIF files. To avoid entanglement with the Unisys LZW patent, GIF reading support has been removed altogether, and the GIF writer has been simplified to produce uncompressed GIFs. This technique does not use the LZW algorithm; the resulting GIF files are larger than usual, but are readable by all standard GIF decoders.
